policy: A dataset or website being public does not automatically grant permission to use every document for model pretraining. Each document/source collection requires license review and explicit approval before ingestion.

candidate_sources.name: Wikimedia Wikipedia dumps
candidate_sources.license: Usually CC BY-SA 4.0 for Wikipedia article text; verify project/page exceptions and preserve attribution and ShareAlike obligations.

candidate_sources.name: PleIAs Common Corpus
candidate_sources.license: Dataset reports document-level provenance and open-licensed/public-domain material. Inspect the dataset card and per-document rights metadata; do not assume one blanket license.

candidate_sources.name: Stack Exchange public data
candidate_sources.license: Contributions have version-dependent CC BY-SA terms; determine the applicable license for each post/revision and preserve attribution/share-alike requirements.

excluded_by_default: arbitrary web crawls with unclear rights
unreviewed synthetic text presented as factual source material
